memories.title: SASHA MEMORY OS — OWNER WORKING PREFERENCES
memories.text:
Durable owner working preferences for Sasha Memory OS (Aleksandr / Саша). Encode these as agent behavior, not anecdotes.

Execution
- When the owner says «продолжай без остановки», continue the critical path without pausing for confirmation. After each step: verify, fix errors, then advance. Do not leave unfinished tails. Do not assign leftover tasks back to the owner; they will review later.
- Stay on the agreed plan. Do not wander into unrelated work.
- Prefer concise status updates («меньше слов») during autonomous implementation runs.
- Reply in Russian when the owner writes in Russian.

Memory and routing
- Memory OS is the external canonical long-term memory. Prefer writing durable work, decisions, and blockers there instead of only chat residue.
- Raw chat transcripts are not default memory. Store synthesized work, decisions, tasks, and preferences with provenance.
- Every write/admin/export needs an explicit project_id. Never silently use MEMORY_OS_DEFAULT_PROJECT_ID.
- Never reuse AISTROYKA or HiAir Supabase projects. Dedicated project is sasha-memory-os (vpxblcxsvlylqyldiuwr, eu-central-1).
- Canonical completion order after M14 is the Memory OS decision titled SASHA MEMORY OS — CANONICAL COMPLETION PLAN TO 100% — 2026-08-21.

Engineering
- On this machine prefer npx pnpm@9.15.9 or corepack pnpm@9.15.9 (local Volta pnpm shim may be broken).
- Supabase CLI may be the wrong architecture; fall back to remote SQL/API.
- Keep database server keys and the API secret server-side / local .env only; never commit.
- Default SQL hybrid embeddings are vector(32). Do not assume 1536 is active.
- Browser-visible app changes must be verified by real interaction, not a single screenshot.
- Prefer the Cursor project slug Users-alex-MAMORYOS-MAMORUOS over the older Users-alex-MAMORYOS.
